Meanings and pronunciations: Wiktionary

Word meanings and most pronunciations are from English Wiktionary, by its contributors, under CC BY-SA 4.0. Many meanings have been shortened, simplified or reworded, and this adapted text is available under the same licence. To see a word's original entry and its authors, go to en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ followed by the word. The entries were read using the kaikki.org extract made with Wiktextract by Tatu Ylonen.

Difficulty levels

Difficulty levels are based on word frequencies published by Peter Norvig, derived from the Google Web Trillion Word Corpus.
